sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing. sources.title: ByT5: Towards a Token-Free Future with Pre-trained
sources.snippet: We aim for ByT5 to cover the same use cases as mT5: it is a general-purpose pre-trained text-to-text model covering 100+ languages. We expect ByT5 will be particular useful for tasks operating on short-to-medium length text sequences (a few sentences or less), as these will incur less slowdown in fine-tuning and inference.
